skills.name: Corrode Bones (蚀骸/蝕骸)
skills.description: SP Kidoumaru commands demons to launch a 2-strike attack on a single target, dealing damage equal to 50% of his ATK with each strike.

skills.name: Lock Soul(骨锁拥魂/魂の骨鎖)
skills.line: Embrace this joy with your soul.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. SP Kidoumaru lays a hunting trap while the hunter stalks outside the web's reach. Enemies' skills prioritise targets other than SP Kidoumaru. He loses this effect when he has Web of Souls. ;Upon Usage :SP Kidoumaru inflicts Delirious on 1 enemy and he gains 2 Web of Souls stacks.If he doesn't have Web of Souls while using this skill, increases his move bar by 40%. ; Web of Souls (魂网/魂の網) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Maintains the Delirious effect and grants him immunity to control effects. Removes 1 stack at the end of his turn or when he's inflicted with a control effect. :''(SP Kidoumaru has a separate yellow stack of Web of Souls to indicate how many stacks of Web of Souls he has lost. Max of 2 stacks.)'' ; Delirious (失魂) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': At the start of turn, has a 60% base chance of forcing the enemy to use a normal attack on a random ally. Can only be inflicted on 1 target at a single time. Does not effect monsters.

upgrades.text: '''Web of Souls''': Each stack grants him 20% of damage reduction.
'''Web of Souls''': Damage reduction increases to 30%.
Upon using this skill, number of Web of Souls stacks gained increases to 3.

skills.name: Lost in Demon City (迷迹鬼城/彷徨う鬼城)
skills.line: Lose yourself in the warm hunting ground.
skills.description: SP Kidoumaru brings Demon City, the land of strife, to the battlefield. He commands the demons he's hunting to launch a 3-strike attack on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 77% of his ATK with each hit and 50% of HP Steal. Also prevents the target's place on the move bar from being altered, lasts for 2 turns. If he has Web of Souls, the damage is inflicted onto all enemies. ; Web of Souls (魂网/魂の網) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 3 stacks. Maintains the Delirious effect and grants him immunity to control effects. Removes 1 stack at the end of his turn or when he's inflicted with a control effect. :''(SP Kidoumaru has a separate yellow stack of Web of Souls to indicate how many stacks of Web of Souls he has lost. Max of 2 stacks.)''

upgrades.text: If he has Web of Souls upon using this skill, he gains 1 Web of Souls stacks.

Whenever he loses 2 Web of Souls stacks, and if he is not immobile, he uses Hunting Strike to launch a 2-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 49% of his ATK with each strike. Does not trigger enemies' souls.
